news_risk: No adverse regulatory action or negative press found in the sources reachable. Note: the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the whole session and Google returned HTTP 429, so news coverage could not be swept systematically; absence of findings here is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. One incidental third-party reference: in Merck Ltd vs Assessee (ITAT Mumbai, 31.03.2016) Nivedita Chemicals is mentioned as a contract manufacturer whose facility standards were compared unfavourably in a transfer-pricing/pharmacopoeia-quality dispute involving Merck - a quality-perception remark in another party's case, not a finding against Nivedita.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. No Russian/CIS counterparty, contract, shipment or payment reference surfaced in any reachable source. Status: not confirmed, and not excluded - trade-record databases (customs/B-L, ImportGenius, Volza) were not reachable in this session.
note: Sanctions: OpenSanctions consolidated dataset (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others), data current as of 2026-11-27, returned 'No matching entities were found' for 'Nivedita Chemicals' (https://www.opensanctions.org/search/?q=Nivedita+Chemicals). No sanctions exposure identified. Court record: the company is a frequent litigant, but exclusively in tax and customs/excise forums - six ITAT Mumbai income-tax appeals (AY 2009-10 through 2014-15, 2017-2020) and two CESTAT matters (1985 customs classification, 2001 central excise). These are routine assessment/classification disputes, not fraud, insolvency or criminal proceedings; per project rules they are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Address appearing in ITAT records: A-14, MIDC Cross Road No. 5, Andheri, Mumbai. Credit rating: null - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action found; not public in reachable sources. Regulator actions: none found beyond the tax/customs adjudication above. Research caveats: the primary search tool was unavailable (connection refused) and Google rate-limited, so this is a partial sweep; Zauba Corp returned HTTP 403 and the OpenSanctions API required a key, so registry-level and PEP-adjacent checks are incomplete. No CIN, PAN or financial figures are asserted here - none were verifiable.
